statement: AMD landed Anthropic as a named MI450 design win and, per the same investor-relations index, will begin shipping Helios rack-scale systems to customers including Microsoft in the second half of 2026.
why: Two marquee customers announced within three days shows AMD's rack-scale platform is being adopted by the largest AI buyers, which is the practical test of whether a second merchant-GPU source exists.

impact.mechanism: Named hyperscaler and frontier-lab commitments to Helios racks establish an alternative rack-scale platform alongside the incumbent, broadening buyer choice.

evidence.excerpt: will begin shipping Helios to customers, including Microsoft, in the second half of 2026
Running across a diversified range of hardware lets us map the right workloads to the right hardware.

confidence.basis: Primary investor-relations releases from the vendor naming its own customers and shipping window.
